messages:
sophie: CI alert — PR #20501 microbench 'kv-eviction-prefetch' failed threshold (+12% latency). CI job: microbench-kv-evict-2026-03-20. CI artifacts: https://ci.redwood/example/artifacts/20501
ci-bot: job failed on runner gpu-ci-07, perf delta 12.4% vs baseline 172ms -> 193.6ms
maria: seeing similar on shadow fleet. Not a one-off.
josh: bisect points to commit 9c3f4b7 (PR 20495) — changes to prefetch sampler + new eviction watermark tweak.
sophie: that's the prefetch/prefill change. Could cause more eviction churn at midseq.
ryan: can reproduce locally with bench dev script. attaching flamegraph snippet: (truncated)
```
# run
./tools/bench --test kv-evict --iters 200 --seqlen 128
# sample output
kv_prefetch_worker  48.2%  
kv_eviction_scan     22.1%
attention_kernel     10.5%
```

maria: interesting — kv_eviction_scan goes from 5% to 22% when prefetch engaged.
josh: hypothesis: prefetch now populates cache aggressively causing fast churn and extra scans.
sophie: plan: 1) reproduce with ci microbench harness 2) narrow with bisect to line-level 3) if repro, open revert PR for the sampler tweak and run canary
ryan: I'm running a focused bench on gpu-ci-07 now — will post profiler
ci-bot: started rerun: microbench-kv-evict x 3 (id: rerun-1715001250)
ryan: profiler: stack shows spike in evict_scan -> slab_scan_inner -> lock contention

# quick patch:
- revert sampler change (9c3f4b7) on a sandbox branch and rerun.

josh: creating revert PR now: #20504 , kick CI
sophie: set rollout block on PR 20501 until we resolve. :no_entry_sign:
maria: if revert reduces latency we can rework prefetch thresholds.
ci-bot: rerun complete: median latency back to baseline (171ms) on revert branch
sophie: great — merge revert, then open follow-up to adjust prefetch watermark with better telemetry.
josh: merge revert PR 20504 — will monitor canary in staging. :thumbsup:
maria: leaving this for postmortem, but tldr: prefetch + aggressive fill caused increased eviction scan & lock contention under midseq workloads.
ryan: I'll add a perf unit test reproducing the eviction-churn scenario.
sophie: thanks all. assigning postmortem to josh/maria. :spiral_note_pad:
